Theme

Latin word

excipiō

excipiō, excipere

verb, third conjugation

catch; make an exception of, leave out; except, make an exception of; welcome (someone arriving); take down (what is said)

In this lexicon

  • catch

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 44; Traupman 45; Traupman 287

  • exception

    also used · classical · Cic. Cat. 4.15: hōsce ego hominēs excipiō et sēcernō libenter (Lewis & Short); Hor. Ep. 1.10.50: exceptō quod, except that (Lewis & Short)

  • exclude

    also used · classical

  • receive

    also used · classical · Liv. 3.26.11: trēs obviam ēgressī fīliī excipiunt; Traupman 405

  • take notes

    the recommended word · classical · Suet. Tit. 3: notīs quoque excipere vēlōcissimē solitum, to take down in shorthand (Lewis & Short); Traupman 32

  • sonī imāginem excipiō, excipere, excēpī, exceptum: record

    modern
